# Record Status

## Summary
The record's own existence lifecycle — `Draft → Active → Archived`, with Archived always reversible. Deliberately distinct from any domain status: a quest can be mid-flight and archived, an invoice paid and archived. This field answers only "is this record part of the working set?", which is what makes generic Archive/Restore commands and working-view filters possible across domains. Built as a configuration of the catalog `statusField` factory, so it inherits the constrained dropdown, the hue-checked pills, and the transition graph (`canTransition`/`nextStatuses`) for free.

## Usage
```ts
import RecordStatusField from '@cardstack/catalog/fields/record-status/record-status-field';

@field recordStatus = contains(RecordStatusField);
```
Archived is a soft delete: kept, queryable, hidden from working views — a consumer's list query filters `recordStatus != 'Archived'` rather than deleting anything. Primitive field — inline `containedExamples` unsupported in base.

## Non-goals
Domain process states (Open/Resolved, planned/done) belong in a consumer-configured `statusField` — never mixed into this set. Hard deletion is the platform's file-delete, not a status. Visibility/permissions are not lifecycle; a Draft is not "private", it is "not ready".
